provider_page.title: Provider
ext.install_url.label: Install from a URL
ext.install_url.hint: Link to a .kai package or a hosted manifest.json (https)
ext.kill_switch.banner: Every extension is off. Titles show no sources until you turn them back on with "Enable all".
ext.updates.title: Extension updates
ext.updates.none.title: Everything is up to date
ext.updates.none.body: Installed extensions match the latest version of their repository or install link.
ext.updates.auto_hint: At start-up and then on the interval below; Extensions shows a badge when something is new
ext.updates.notify_hint: When updates are found, open the list once per session
extserver.title: Extension servers
extserver.intro: Pair with a Tatakai extension server on your network to use its sources here (Aniyomi, Mihon, CloudStream, Sora, Mangayomi, Seanime and .kai extensions installed there).
extserver.empty.title: No paired servers
extserver.empty.body: Open the server's pairing code on the other PC and paste the link or the address with the code.
extserver.fallback_hint: When a server does not answer, skip it quickly and keep using the extensions installed on this PC
extserver.offline_banner: The server did not answer. Local extensions keep working.
extserver.offline_banner_detail: The server did not answer ({detail}). Local extensions keep working.
extserver.sources.empty: This server offers no sources yet.
extserver.remove.title: Remove this server?
extserver.remove.body: {name} is forgotten and its access token revoked. You can pair it again later.
extserver.pair.title: Pair with an extension server
extserver.pair.intro: Paste the pairing link, or type the server address with its one-time code or the viewer password.
extserver.pair.code_hint: The one-time code the server shows (expires in 5 minutes)
extserver.pair.password_hint: Only when the server uses a password instead of codes
extserver.pair.name: Name on this PC
extserver.deep_link.title: Connect to an extension server?
extserver.deep_link.body: A pairing link was opened. Connect this app to {server}?
extserver.error.authentication_required: The server asks to pair again.
extserver.error.pairing_required: This server needs a pairing code or password.
extserver.error.pairing_expired: The pairing code expired. Ask the server for a new one.
extserver.error.device_not_authorized: This device was revoked on the server. Pair it again.
extserver.error.pairing_limit: The server has too many pending pairing codes.
extserver.error.setup_required: The server has not been set up yet.
extserver.error.invalid_code: That pairing code is not valid.
extserver.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
stremio.title: Stremio add-ons
stremio.intro: Paste the manifest URL of a Stremio add-on: its streams show in the source picker with the add-on's name.
stremio.enabled_hint: Ask the enabled add-ons for streams of every episode
stremio.empty.title: No add-ons
stremio.empty.body: Add-ons for anime that serve streams by Kitsu or MAL id work best.
stremio.remove.title: Remove this add-on?
repo.title: Repositories
repo.intro: Add the URL of an extension index (JSON) to browse its .kai packages and install them with one click.
repo.empty.title: No repositories
repo.empty.body: An index lists packages with id, name, version and the URL of each .kai.
repo.remove.title: Remove this repository?
repo.remove.body: {name} is removed from the list. Installed extensions stay.
provider_page.list.title: Provider pages
provider_page.list.intro: Extensions that bring their own catalogue. Open one to browse its rows and search it.
provider_page.list.empty.title: No provider pages
provider_page.list.empty.body: Install an extension that declares custom sources to browse its catalogue here.
provider_page.list.disabled: Enable the extension to open its page.
provider_page.saved.empty: Titles you save from a provider show here.
provider_page.empty.title: This provider has no rows
provider_page.empty.body: Use its search to find titles.
